name: OGB
description: Open Graph Benchmark — large-scale standardised graph ML benchmarks covering graph-level, node-level, and link-level prediction across diverse domains.

name: MoleculeNet
description: MoleculeNet — benchmark collection for molecular machine learning.

name: Heterogeneous Graph Benchmarks
description: Heterogeneous graph datasets from the MAGNN and HGB benchmark papers.

name: Quantum Chemistry
description: Quantum chemistry molecular property prediction benchmarks.

name: LRGB
description: Long Range Graph Benchmark — five graph ML tasks designed to test long-range dependency modelling. Introduced by Dwivedi et al. (2022).

name: Heterophily Benchmark
description: Five replacement datasets proposed for more reliable evaluation under graph heterophily.

name: GNNBenchmark
description: Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks — artificially and semi-artificially generated graph datasets.

name: LINKX Benchmarks
description: Large-scale non-homophilous graph benchmarks from LINKX and related evaluations.

name: Other Graph Benchmarks
description: Miscellaneous graph learning datasets used across various papers: malware detection, 3D point clouds, text graphs, and large-scale graphs.

name: Knowledge Graphs
description: Knowledge graph completion and link prediction benchmarks.

name: Hypergraph Benchmarks
description: Hypergraph node classification benchmarks used in heterophily-aware and non-dissipative hypergraph GNN papers (AllSet, HyperGCN, etc.). Datasets span multiple source papers; AllSet is the partial group anchor.

name: GraphBench
description: GraphBench — a comprehensive graph learning benchmark covering diverse graph types and tasks spanning social networks, hardware design, logic, earth systems, and algorithmic reasoning.

name: Algorithmic Graph Tasks
description: Algorithmic graph property prediction tasks (SSSP, eccentricity, etc.) used as benchmarks for expressive GNNs.

name: DualEquiNet RNA Benchmarks
description: RNA 3D structure prediction benchmarks used in DualEquiNet (equivariant graph network for biological molecule geometry). Includes ribosome and synthetic RNA datasets.

name: ECHO Benchmark
description: ECHO — a benchmark for long-range graph propagation in physical simulation domains (synthetic, charge, and energy propagation tasks).

name: City-Networks
description: City-Networks — a large-scale long-range benchmark on real-world city road graphs, introduced to test transductive node classification under very large graph diameters.

name: LRIM Graph Benchmark
description: LRIM — the Long-Range Ising Model Graph Benchmark, a physics-grounded suite for controlled long-range graph learning evaluation across ten datasets spanning multiple graph sizes and difficulty levels.

name: Power Flow Benchmarks
description: Power grid test cases for scale-adaptive power flow analysis with graph neural networks. Cases correspond to standard IEEE power system test networks.

name: HSG-12M
description: HSG-12M — a large-scale benchmark of Heterogeneous Spatial Graphs from real-world geospatial infrastructure data (transport, utilities, land-use).

name: Classic
description: Classic node/graph classification and regression benchmarks.

name: TU Dortmund
description: TU Dortmund graph kernel benchmark datasets for graph classification.

name: Heterophilic Graphs
description: Legacy heterophilic node classification benchmarks with known evaluation problems (WebKB, Wikipedia, and the five-class Actor graph).
